scope: Local unit, isolated PostgreSQL and dashboard regression checks; production verification follows delivery

definition.total: All users, including blocked accounts and bootstrap administrator
definition.registration: Account created_at falls within Moscow calendar day
definition.daily_active: Distinct authenticated accounts with at least one successfully verified server request, including background requests
definition.comparison: Today so far versus complete previous calendar day
definition.initial_history: No historical DAU is inferred; incomplete previous day and percentage with zero baseline stay unavailable

checks: Focused tests failed before implementation, then passed
Six observe_usage tests PASS, including isolated PostgreSQL 17.6 integration
Existing authenticate_session service, API and PostgreSQL tests PASS
All migrate tests PASS with both test database variables configured; empty/existing schema and repeat migration covered
Eight Runtime dashboard Python regressions PASS
preservation: Telemetry write errors do not change authentication result
One successful activity write per cached account/day; 200 ms deadline, retry on failure, bounded 16384-entry cache
Activity survives process restart; date-indexed deduplication and retention in PostgreSQL
Only aggregate metrics and fixed today/yesterday labels leave the API
Failed metric reads and observations older than 60 seconds are excluded, including stale series from previous releases
Original ten dashboard panel IDs and host-resource panels preserved
